what: Opening curtain covering the screen — a sky photo settles from 1.2x and 15% below into place over 9 seconds as the dark curtain lifts (1 → .2). At .5 seconds starlight enters over 2 seconds, spinning one turn backward from triple size, and the strokes are drawn. From 2 seconds the four big title lines rise from below at .1 second steps (2s), from 3 seconds the tagline lines follow at .5 second steps (2s), and from 4.5 seconds the body lines float in from the left at .1 second steps (1.5s). After 8 seconds (immediately if SKIP) it lifts in .8 seconds and fires fx:open

options.hold: Time until it starts to clear (sec), default 8 — 0 means immediately
options.copy-at · copy-each: Tagline line start and sequence, default 3 · .5
options.[data-fx-part=sky]: Sky photo panel (a veil covers the top)
options.[data-fx-part=head]: One-line title — the parent acts as its masking Frame
options.[data-fx-part=skip]: Press and it lifts right away

note: When the curtain lifts it fires an fx:open event (swelling) — connects to the main screen autoplay (wait: fx:open of noise-dissolve-slides)

from.where: .t-loader (original .l-loader — skymove 9s linear, skyOverlayAnim 9s ease, lightIn 2s .5s, headTxtReveal 2s 2s+.1s, lineTxtAnim1 2s 3s+.5s, lineTxtAnim2 1.5s 4.5s+.1s, loaderOut .8s ease 8s, SKIP is 0s)
